title: Componentwise McShane extension into ℝ^P with constant √P·K
statement: Lipschitz extension into Euclidean space (componentwise McShane). Let P ∈ ℕ, S ⊆ ℝ^P, ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P and K ∈ ℝ≥0 such that ψ is K-Lipschitz on S (LipschitzOnWith K ψ S: ‖ψ(x) − ψ(y)‖ ≤ K‖x − y‖ for x, y ∈ S). Then there is φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P which is (√P·K)-Lipschitz on all of ℝ^P (LipschitzWith (NNReal.sqrt P * K) φ, where P is cast to ℝ≥0) and agrees with ψ on S (EqOn φ ψ S).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (K : NNReal), LipschitzOnWith K ψ S → ∃ φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, LipschitzWith (NNReal.sqrt P * K) φ ∧ EqOn φ ψ S
